name: MISONR DRAFT Basic Custody Screening v0.5
description: OAS0008  v0.3.1  Establishment level report of Basic Custody Screening completions

dataset.name: BCSCompletions
dataset.query: dataset_base_ AS (SELECT ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.RECEPTION_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ASSESSMENT.ASSESSMENT_ID) AS COUNT_OF_ASSESSMENTS, BCS_PART_STATUS.DESCRIPTION, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_COMP_DATE, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_EST_NAME, ASSESSMENT.ASSESSMENT_ID, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_EST_OPOL, OFFENDER.FAMILY_NAME, COALESCE(SUBSTR(OFFENDER.FORENAME, 1, INSTR(OFFENDER.FORENAME, ' ')), OFFENDER.FORENAME) AS FIRST_NAME, OFFENDER.DATE_OF_BIRTH, OFFENDER.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_SCREENER, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.DATE_COMPLETED, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.ACTUAL_RELEASE_DATE FROM ASSESSMENT, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID, BCS_PART_STATUS, OFFENDER WHERE (OFFENDER.OFFENDER_ID = ASSESSMENT.OFFENDER_ID (+)) AND (ASSESSMENT.ASSESSMENT_ID = ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.ASSESSMENT_ID AND ASSESSMENT.ASSESSMENT_TYPE_ELM = 'TR_BCS') AND (BCS_PART_STATUS.BCS_PART_STATUS_CODE (+) = ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_STATUS) AND (SUBSTR(OFFENDER.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, 1, 10) = TAGMIS_CASELOAD_SECURITY('CQI37G', OFFENDER.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY)) AND (ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_SYSTEM_CREATED_IND = 1 AND ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.RECEPTION_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE('01-04-2015 00:00:00', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE('21-08-2015 00:00:00', 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AND ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_EST_NAME = 'Leeds (HMP)') GROUP BY ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.RECEPTION_DATE, BCS_PART_STATUS.DESCRIPTION, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_COMP_DATE, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_EST_NAME, ASSESSMENT.ASSESSMENT_ID, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_PART1_EST_OPOL, OFFENDER.FAMILY_NAME, COALESCE(SUBSTR(OFFENDER.FORENAME, 1, INSTR(OFFENDER.FORENAME, ' ')), OFFENDER.FORENAME), OFFENDER.DATE_OF_BIRTH, OFFENDER.OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.BCS_SCREENER, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.DATE_COMPLETED, ASSESSMENT_BCS_CASEID.ACTUAL_RELEASE_DATE), dataset_ AS (SELECT RECEPTION_DATE, COUNT_OF_ASSESSMENTS, DESCRIPTION, BCS_PART1_COMP_DATE, BCS_PART1_EST_NAME, ASSESSMENT_ID, BCS_PART1_EST_OPOL, FAMILY_NAME, FIRST_NAME, DATE_OF_BIRTH, OFFENDER_ID_DISPLAY, BCS_SCREENER, DATE_COMPLETED, ACTUAL_RELEASE_DATE, TO_DATE(RECEPTION_DATE, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS V_RECEPTION_DATE_DISPLAY, SUM(CASE WHEN BCS_PART1_COMP_DATE <= V_TARGET_DATE AND DESCRIPTION = 'Complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS V_COMPLETED_ON_TIME, SUM(CASE WHEN BCS_PART1_COMP_DATE > V_TARGET_DATE AND DESCRIPTION = 'Complete' OR DESCRIPTION = 'Locked Incomplete' AND V_LOCKED_INCOMPLETE_BEFORE_TARGET = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS V_NOT_COMPLETED_ON_TIME, SUM(V_LOCKED_INCOMPLETE_BEFORE_TARGET) AS V_RELEASED_SUM, SUM(CASE WHEN DESCRIPTION = 'Unallocated' OR DESCRIPTION = 'WIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS V_WORK_IN_PROGRESS, CASE WHEN V_COMPLETED_ON_TIME = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE CASE WHEN V_LOCKED_INCOMPLETE_BEFORE_TARGET = 1 THEN 'Released' ELSE 'No' END END AS V_COMPLETED_ON_TIME_DISPLAY FROM dataset_base_)

filter.name: prefilter_
filter.query: prefilter_ AS (SELECT * FROM dataset_ WHERE V_AGE_AT_RECEPTION >= 18)

field.name: $ref:V_COMPLETED_ON_TIME
field.legacySql: =Sum(If([BCS Part1 Completion Date]<=[v Target Date] And [BCS Part1 Status] = "Complete";1;0))

field.name: $ref:V_NOT_COMPLETED_ON_TIME
field.legacySql:
=Sum(If(
([BCS Part1 Completion Date]>[v Target Date] And [BCS Part1 Status] = "Complete") 
Or 
([BCS Part1 Status] = "Locked Incomplete" And [v Locked Incomplete Before Target] = 0);1;0))

field.name: $ref:V_COMPLETED_ON_TIME
field.legacySql: =[v Completed on Time]/[Count of Assessments] Where ([v Locked Incomplete Before Target] = 0)

filter.name: prefilter_
filter.query: prefilter_ AS (SELECT * FROM dataset_ WHERE V_AGE_AT_RECEPTION >= 18)

field.name: $ref:V_COMPLETED_ON_TIME_DISPLAY
field.legacySql: =If([v Completed on Time]=1;"Yes"; If([v Locked Incomplete Before Target]=1;"Released"; "No"))
